title: Persistent problem. V3+ with enabled websockets / no synchronization with client.
body:
I have already mentioned the problem several times. 3.3.1.0 does not fix the error either. As soon as you use several AAPS clients and all have activated websockets, only 1 device runs properly for a maximum of 12 hours, after which it behaves exactly like the other follower devices, which cannot synchronize the BG values ​​with active websockets from the start. All other data arrives. Even a new, clean installation did not help. The solution is - master (websockets activated), follower (websockets deactivated).

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18361575/AndroidAPS.log)

comments.body:

Similar problem here, so adding my information here instead of creating separate issue. I have 2 kids using AAPS, I follow them continuously via AAPSClient and AAPSClient2 on my phone, and both client apps are also set up on their dad's phone and my mother's, so they can both have info when they're taking care of the kids. 

I posted on facebook first on 3.3.0:
I have a weird problem after updating to 3.3. The problem is in AAPSclient, but not AAPSClient2, and only on my phone, not my mother's phone. Apparently BG values only download occasionally, even though they are present in nightscout so i can get them continuously on my watch, on kid's watch and everywhere else that downloads from nightscout. I've tried reinstalling the app, clearing cache, clearing data, multiple restarts on both phones, running a full sync from NS (backfilling previous data, but will not fix the ongoing problem). Before update, and after update for the other kid (AAPSClient2), data is synced continuously.
